Mauro Junior (groin), Sami Ouaissa (muscle), Adamo Nagalo, Alassane Plea and Jerdy Schouten (ACL) remain unavailable for PSV; however, Ricardo Pepi should feature in some capacity after remaining on the bench in Madrid.

No player has scored more Eredivisie goals than Sven Mijnans, with the versatile attacking midfielder registering nine strikes and three assists in the top flight. [...] Guus Til is likely to lead the attack despite Pepi's availability, while Ruben van Bommel offers a dual threat after contributing five goals and three assists.

Soren Tengstedt shares Mijnans's position atop the league's scoring charts, with no player outscoring the Kowet forward this season.

Stefan Ingi Sigurdarson (four goals, one assist) and Mathis Suray (three goals, four assists) also possess match-winning quality that Oosting will hope comes to the fore at the Philips Stadion.

data.content:
Go Ahead Eagles are ninth with 17 points from 13 Eredivisie matches. They have won four, drawn five and lost four, scoring 24 goals while conceding 28. Those figures describe a team capable of contributing in attack but less secure defensively than PSV. Their away record is a particular concern ahead of this trip: one win, three draws and three defeats from seven league matches. They have shown that they can avoid defeat on the road, but turning those draws into wins has been difficult. [...] Peter Bosz’s PSV enter this fixture at the top of the Eredivisie table with 29 points from 13 matches. Their record stands at nine wins, two draws and two defeats, with 44 goals scored and 16 conceded. That attacking return is particularly impressive and underlines why PSV have established themselves as the division’s leading side. At Philips Stadion, they have been unbeaten in six league games, winning four and drawing two. The home record gives them a strong platform against a Go Ahead Eagles [...] In the league, PSV have the stronger overall profile: 29 points, first place, 44 goals scored and 16 conceded. Go Ahead Eagles sit ninth on 17 points, with 24 scored and 28 conceded. The contrast is most pronounced at home and away. PSV have collected four wins and two draws at Philips Stadion, whereas Go Ahead Eagles have managed just one win in seven away games.
